items.title: 10.7 Express the Product (of sines and cosines) as Sums or Differences (of sines and cosines) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Aaj ka sabaq trigonometry ka ek bohat kaam ka auzaar hai. Section 10.3 mein humne \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) jaise sum ko khol kar products (zarb) banaye the, jaise \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta\). Aaj hum ulta safar karenge: product ko sum ya difference mein badlenge, aur phir sum ko product mein. Sawal yeh hai ke yeh ulta kaam kyun? Kyun ke kai sawalon mein product ke saath kaam mushkil hota hai aur sum ke saath aasan, aur kai mein iske bar-aks. Jaise ek ghar ki do chaabiyan hon: jo darwaza jis chaabi se khule, wohi istemal karo.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Poore sabaq ka raaz ek line mein: purane chaar formulas mein se do do ko jama (add) ya tafreeq (subtract) karo, taa ke ek term cancel ho jaye aur doosra double ho jaye. Bas itni si baat hai. Is liye pehle woh chaar formulas taaza kar lijiye jo aap 10.3 mein parh chuke hain.

Hum jaante hain ke:
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta)\]
\[= \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(i)}\]
\[\sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(ii)}\]
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta)\]
\[= \cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(iii)}\]
\[\cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(iv)}\]

(i) aur (ii) ko jama karne se:
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= 2\sin\alpha\cos\beta \quad \text{(v)}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Dekhiye kya hua: (i) mein \(+\cos\alpha\sin\beta\) hai aur (ii) mein \(-\cos\alpha\sin\beta\). Jama karne par yeh dono ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain, aur \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta\) do dafa aa kar \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\) ban jata hai.

(i) mein se (ii) ko tafreeq karne se:
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= 2\cos\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(vi)}\]

(iii) aur (iv) ko jama karne se:
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta \quad \text{(vii)}\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab (vii) ko \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\) chhapti hai, yani beech mein minus. Lekin kitab khud likhti hai "(iii) aur (iv) ko jama karne se", aur jama karne par plus aata hai: \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\). (iii) ka \(-\sin\alpha\sin\beta\) aur (iv) ka \(+\sin\alpha\sin\beta\) cancel ho jate hain. Kitab ka apna box neeche sahi \(+\) dikhata hai.

(iii) mein se (iv) ko tafreeq karne se:
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[= -2\sin\alpha\sin\beta \quad \text{(viii)}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: (viii) mein sab se zyada ghalti hoti hai, is liye dheere se dekhiye: \((\cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta) - (\cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta)\). Bracket kholte waqt doosre bracket ke dono terms ka sign badal jata hai: \(\cos\alpha\cos\beta\) cancel, aur \(-\sin\alpha\sin\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta = -2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\). Yahi minus sign aage tak saath chalta hai.
Is tarah humein chaar identities milti hain:

blocks.title: Four product identities
blocks.text:
\[2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[2\cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
\[-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Sawal mein kaun sa formula lagana hai? Product ko dekh kar faisla kijiye:
\(\sin \times \cos\) (pehle sine): pehli line.
\(\cos \times \sin\) (pehle cosine): doosri line.
\(\cos \times \cos\): teesri line.
\(\sin \times \sin\): chauthi line, aur iska minus sign mat bhooliye.
Bara angle \(\alpha\) banaiye taa ke \(\alpha - \beta\) positive rahe. Har formula ke aage 2 hai; agar sawal mein 2 nahin hai to 2 se multiply aur 2 se divide kar dijiye, value nahin badlegi.

Ab \(\alpha + \beta = P\) aur \(\alpha - \beta = Q\) rakhte hain, to:
\[\alpha + \beta = P, \quad \alpha - \beta = Q\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{P + Q}{2}, \quad \beta = \dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Woh qadam jo kitab chhor deti hai: dono equations jama karein to \(2\alpha = P + Q\), yani \(\alpha = \frac{P + Q}{2}\). Tafreeq karein to \(2\beta = P - Q\), yani \(\beta = \frac{P - Q}{2}\). Yeh values upar wali chaar identities mein rakhne se agla box banta hai. Aasan lafzon mein: do angles ka aadha jor (half sum) aur aadha farq (half difference).

blocks.title: Sum and difference identities
blocks.text:
\[\sin P + \sin Q\]
\[= 2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
\[\sin P - \sin Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
\[\cos P + \cos Q\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\cos\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]
\[\cos P - \cos Q\]
\[= -2\sin\dfrac{P + Q}{2}\sin\dfrac{P - Q}{2}\]

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Is box ko yaad karne ka aasan tareeqa:
sin + sin = 2 sin(aadha jor) cos(aadha farq)
sin − sin = 2 cos(aadha jor) sin(aadha farq)
cos + cos = 2 cos(aadha jor) cos(aadha farq)
cos − cos = −2 sin(aadha jor) sin(aadha farq)
Sirf aakhri mein minus hai, aur har line mein aadha jor pehle aata hai. Exam mein formula pehle likh dein, phir values rakhein; is se ghalti ka imkaan kam aur examiner ko aap ka tareeqa saaf nazar aata hai.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Pehle box (product se sum) aur doosre box (sum se product) ko aapas mein mat milaiye. Pehchaan ka aasan tareeqa: agar sawal mein do functions zarb (multiply) ho rahe hain, jaise \(\sin 7\theta\cos 3\theta\), to pehla box. Agar do functions jama ya tafreeq ho rahe hain, jaise \(\sin 5x + \sin 7x\), to doosra box. Sawal ke alfaaz bhi madad karte hain: "express as a sum or difference" ka matlab pehla box, aur "express as a product" ka matlab doosra box. Ek aur baat: dono boxes asal mein ek hi baat hain, sirf ulti taraf se likhi hui. Agar ek box yaad ho to doosra \(P\) aur \(Q\) rakh kar khud bana sakte hain, jaise humne upar banaya.

Ab kitab ki misaalon par yeh formulas chala kar dekhte hain. Pehli do misaalon mein product ko sum banayenge, aur baad wali misaalon mein sum ko product. Har misaal mein pehle shakal pehchaanenge, phir formula likhenge, phir values rakhenge. Yeh teen qadam ki aadat exam mein bohat kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Example 14
blocks.problem: Express \(2\sin 7\theta\cos 3\theta\) as a sum or difference.
steps:
Given: product \(2\sin 7\theta\cos 3\theta\).
To find: isi ko sum ya difference ki shakal mein likhna.
Method: sab se pehle product ki shakal pehchaanein: pehle sine, phir cosine, aur aage 2 bhi maujood hai. Yeh bilkul \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\) hai, is liye formula \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\) lagega.

Step 1: Angles pehchaanna
\[\alpha = 7\theta, \quad \beta = 3\theta\]
Kyun: formula ki left side se mila kar dekhne se pata chalta hai ke right side mein kya rakhna hai. Bara angle \(7\theta\) hai, woh \(\alpha\) bana, taa ke farq positive aaye.

Step 2: Formula lagana
\[2\sin 7\theta\cos 3\theta\]
\[= \sin(7\theta + 3\theta) + \sin(7\theta - 3\theta)\]
\[= \sin 10\theta + \sin 4\theta\]
Kyun: \(7\theta + 3\theta = 10\theta\) aur \(7\theta - 3\theta = 4\theta\). Bas jor aur farq nikalna tha.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 15^{\circ}\) lein, to \(7\theta = 105^{\circ}\), \(3\theta = 45^{\circ}\).
\[2\sin 105^{\circ}\cos 45^{\circ}\]
\[= 2\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{6} + \sqrt{2}}{4}\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{2}}{2} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2}\]
\[\sin 150^{\circ} + \sin 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Dono taraf \(\frac{1 + \sqrt{3}}{2}\) aaya. Jawab pakka.

blocks.title: Example 15
blocks.problem: Prove without using table / calculator, that \(\sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ} + \sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\)
steps:
Given: \(\sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ} + \sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ}\).
To prove: yeh \(\frac{1}{2}\) ke barabar hai, table ya calculator ke baghair.
Method: \(19^{\circ}\), \(11^{\circ}\), \(71^{\circ}\) standard angles nahin, in ki values hum zabani nahin jaante. Lekin in ke jor aur farq dekhiye: \(30^{\circ}\), \(8^{\circ}\), \(82^{\circ}\), \(60^{\circ}\). Yeh ya to standard hain ya ek doosre ke complement (\(8^{\circ} + 82^{\circ} = 90^{\circ}\)). Is liye dono products ko sums mein badlenge.

Step 1: 2 ka factor banana
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ} + \sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[2\sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ}\right.\]
\[\left.\quad + 2\sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ}\right]\]
Kyun: product identities mein \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\) aur \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\) hain, lekin sawal mein 2 nahin. 2 se multiply aur 2 se divide karne se value wahi rehti hai, aur formula lagne ke qabil ho jata hai.

Step 2: Pehla product
\[2\sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ}\]
\[= \sin(19^{\circ} + 11^{\circ}) + \sin(19^{\circ} - 11^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin 30^{\circ} + \sin 8^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\), jahan \(\alpha = 19^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 11^{\circ}\).

Step 3: Doosra product
\[2\sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ}\]
\[= -\left[\cos(71^{\circ} + 11^{\circ}) - \cos(71^{\circ} - 11^{\circ})\right]\]
\[= -\cos 82^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}\]
Kyun: chauthi identity \(-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)\) hai. Dono taraf minus lagane se \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = -[\cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)]\). Yahan \(\alpha = 71^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 11^{\circ}\). Dhyan dein: yahi woh minus hai jise students bhool jate hain.

Step 4: Dono ko jorna
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\sin 30^{\circ} + \sin 8^{\circ}\right.\]
\[\left.\quad - \cos 82^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}\right]\]
Kyun: dono products ki jagah un ke sums rakh diye.

Step 5: Complement aur standard values
\[\cos 82^{\circ} = \cos(90^{\circ} - 8^{\circ}) = \sin 8^{\circ}\]
\[\text{L.H.S.}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\dfrac{1}{2} + \sin 8^{\circ} - \sin 8^{\circ} + \dfrac{1}{2}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}\right] = \dfrac{1}{2} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: \(\cos(90^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin\theta\), is liye \(\cos 82^{\circ} = \sin 8^{\circ}\) aur dono cancel ho gaye. Baqi \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) hum zabani jaante hain. Yahi is sawal ki khoobsurti hai: anjaan values khud hi ghaib ho gayin.

Tasdeeq: andaazi values se
\[\sin 19^{\circ}\cos 11^{\circ} \approx 0.3256 \times 0.9816 \approx 0.3196\]
\[\sin 71^{\circ}\sin 11^{\circ} \approx 0.9455 \times 0.1908 \approx 0.1804\]
\[0.3196 + 0.1804 = 0.5000\]

blocks.text: Ab tak humne product ko sum banaya. Agli teen misaalon mein ulta kaam hai: sum ya difference ko product banana. Yeh tab kaam aata hai jab humein kisi expression ko factors mein todna ho, jaise algebra mein \(x^{2} - y^{2} = (x - y)(x + y)\) karte hain. Factors mil jayen to cancel karna aur equations hal karna aasan ho jata hai, aur aage Exercise 10.4 ke proofs mein yahi tareeqa baar baar lagega.

blocks.title: Example 16
steps:
Given: \(\sin 5x + \sin 7x\).
To find: isi ko product ki shakal mein likhna.
Method: do sines ka jor hai, to formula \(\sin P + \sin Q = 2\sin\frac{P + Q}{2}\cos\frac{P - Q}{2}\) lagega. Kaam sirf aadha jor aur aadha farq nikalna hai.

Step 1: Aadha jor aur aadha farq
\[P = 5x, \quad Q = 7x\]
\[\dfrac{P + Q}{2} = \dfrac{12x}{2} = 6x\]
\[\dfrac{P - Q}{2} = \dfrac{-2x}{2} = -x\]
Kyun: product mein yahi do angles aate hain; pehle inhein alag nikal lena hisaab ko saaf rakhta hai.

Step 2: Formula lagana
\[\sin 5x + \sin 7x\]
\[= 2\sin\dfrac{5x + 7x}{2}\cos\dfrac{5x - 7x}{2}\]
\[= 2\sin 6x\cos(-x)\]
Kyun: aadha jor sine mein aur aadha farq cosine mein jata hai.

Step 3: Negative angle hatana
\[= 2\sin 6x\cos x \quad (\because \cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta)\]
Kyun: cosine even function hai, yani \(\cos(-x) = \cos x\). Misal: \(\cos(-60^{\circ}) = \cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\). Aasan raasta: shuru hi mein \(P = 7x\), \(Q = 5x\) le lete to farq seedha \(x\) aata.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 15^{\circ}\) lein.
\[\sin 75^{\circ} + \sin 105^{\circ} = 2\sin 75^{\circ}\]
\[2\sin 90^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ} = 2\cos 15^{\circ} = 2\sin 75^{\circ}\]
kyun ke \(\cos 15^{\circ} = \sin 75^{\circ}\) aur \(\sin 105^{\circ} = \sin 75^{\circ}\). Dono taraf barabar.

blocks.title: Example 17
steps:
Given: \(\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta + \cos 5\theta + \cos 7\theta\).
To find: is ko product banana.
Method: hamara formula \(\cos P + \cos Q\) ek waqt mein sirf do terms leta hai, lekin yahan chaar hain. Is liye inhein do joron (pairs) mein baantenge, har jore ko product banayenge, common factor nikalenge, aur phir formula ek dafa aur lagayenge.

Step 1: Jore banana
\[\cos\theta + \cos 3\theta + \cos 5\theta + \cos 7\theta\]
\[= (\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta) + (\cos 7\theta + \cos 5\theta)\]
Kyun: dono joron mein aadha farq \(\theta\) aata hai, is liye dono se \(\cos\theta\) common niklega. Bara angle pehle likhne se angles positive rehte hain.

Step 2: Pehla jora
\[\cos 3\theta + \cos\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{3\theta + \theta}{2}\cos\dfrac{3\theta - \theta}{2}\]
\[= 2\cos 2\theta\cos\theta\]
Kyun: \(\cos P + \cos Q = 2\cos\frac{P + Q}{2}\cos\frac{P - Q}{2}\), jahan \(P = 3\theta\), \(Q = \theta\).

Step 3: Doosra jora
\[\cos 7\theta + \cos 5\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{7\theta + 5\theta}{2}\cos\dfrac{7\theta - 5\theta}{2}\]
\[= 2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta\]
Kyun: wahi formula, \(P = 7\theta\), \(Q = 5\theta\). Aadha jor \(\frac{12\theta}{2} = 6\theta\). (Kitab yahan ghalti se \(7\theta + \theta\) chhapti hai; neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhiye.)

Step 4: Common factor nikalna
\[= 2\cos 2\theta\cos\theta + 2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\theta(\cos 6\theta + \cos 2\theta)\]
Kyun: dono terms mein \(2\cos\theta\) maujood hai, use bahar nikal liya.

Step 5: Formula dobara
\[\cos 6\theta + \cos 2\theta\]
\[= 2\cos\dfrac{6\theta + 2\theta}{2}\cos\dfrac{6\theta - 2\theta}{2}\]
\[= 2\cos 4\theta\cos 2\theta\]
Kyun: bracket phir se do cosines ka jor hai, to wohi formula phir lag gaya.

Step 6: Product likhna
\[= 2\cos\theta(2\cos 4\theta\cos 2\theta)\]
\[= 4\cos\theta\cos 2\theta\cos 4\theta\]
Kyun: \(2 \times 2 = 4\); factors ki tarteeb se fark nahin parta.

Tasdeeq:
\[\theta = 0^{\circ}: \ 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4 = 4(1)(1)(1)\]
\[\theta = 30^{\circ}: \ \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + 0 - \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = -\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
\[4\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = -\tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 17 mein kitab doosre jore ko \(2\cos\frac{7\theta + \theta}{2}\cos\frac{7\theta - 5\theta}{2}\) chhapti hai. Jora \(\cos 7\theta + \cos 5\theta\) hai, is liye sahi \(2\cos\frac{7\theta + 5\theta}{2}\cos\frac{7\theta - 5\theta}{2} = 2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta\) hai. Kitab ki agli line (\(2\cos 6\theta\cos\theta\)) sahi hai, yani sirf printing ki ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Example 18
steps:
Given: \(\cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ}\).
To prove: yeh product \(\frac{1}{8}\) ke barabar hai.
Method: teen cosines ka product hai. Formula \(2\cos\alpha\cos\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\) do do par lagayenge. Do dafa lagana hai, to do 2 chahiye, yani 4 se multiply aur 4 se divide. Aakhir mein \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) anjaan values ko cancel kar dega.

Step 1: Do 2 ke factor banana
\[\text{L.H.S.} = \cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(4\cos 20^{\circ}\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 80^{\circ})\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left[(2\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ})\cdot 2\cos 80^{\circ}\right]\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{4} \times 4 = 1\), value nahin badli; aur \(4 = 2 \times 2\) se har product formula ko apna 2 mil gaya.

Step 2: Pehla product
\[2\cos 40^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} = \cos 60^{\circ} + \cos 20^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2} + \cos 20^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 40^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 20^{\circ}\); jor \(60^{\circ}\), farq \(20^{\circ}\), aur \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) hum jaante hain.

Step 3: Multiply karna
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left[\left(\dfrac{1}{2} + \cos 20^{\circ}\right)2\cos 80^{\circ}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(\cos 80^{\circ} + 2\cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ})\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2} \times 2\cos 80^{\circ} = \cos 80^{\circ}\), aur doosra hissa \(2\cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ}\) phir se product hai.

Step 4: Doosra product
\[2\cos 80^{\circ}\cos 20^{\circ} = \cos 100^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}(\cos 80^{\circ} + \cos 100^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ})\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 80^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 20^{\circ}\): jor \(100^{\circ}\), farq \(60^{\circ}\).

Step 5: Allied angle
\[\cos 100^{\circ} = \cos(180^{\circ} - 80^{\circ}) = -\cos 80^{\circ}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left[\cos 80^{\circ} - \cos 80^{\circ} + \dfrac{1}{2}\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{4}\left(\dfrac{1}{2}\right) = \dfrac{1}{8} = \text{R.H.S.}\]
Kyun: 10.2 se \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\), is liye \(\cos 100^{\circ} = -\cos 80^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 80^{\circ}\) cancel ho gaya. Sirf \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\) bacha.

Tasdeeq: andaazi values se
\[0.9397 \times 0.7660 \times 0.1736 \approx 0.1250 = \dfrac{1}{8}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 18 ka ek aur sabaq: jab teen cosines ka product ho aur unhein standard angle par khatam karna ho, to do do ko product formula se jor kar sum banate jayein, aur aakhir mein \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) ya \(\cos(90^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin\theta\) jaise allied angles se anjaan terms cancel karayein. Har dafa formula se pehle 2 ka factor banana na bhooliye; teen factors ke liye bahar \(\frac{1}{4}\) aur andar 4 rakhna isi liye zaroori tha. Exercise 10.3 ke aakhri sawal (\(\cos 36^{\circ}\cos 72^{\circ}\cos 108^{\circ}\cos 144^{\circ}\)) mein bhi isi qisam ki soch kaam aati hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ki misaal nahin.
1. \(2\cos 75^{\circ}\cos 15^{\circ}\) nikaliye. Hal: \(= \cos 90^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ} = 0 + \frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\).
2. \(\sin 75^{\circ} + \sin 15^{\circ}\) nikaliye. Hal: \(= 2\sin 45^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} = 2\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \frac{\sqrt{6}}{2}\).
Dekha? Anjaan angles (\(75^{\circ}\), \(15^{\circ}\)) jor aur farq mein standard angles ban gaye.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
1. \(2\sin 3\theta\sin\theta\) ko difference banaiye. (Jawab: \(\cos 2\theta - \cos 4\theta\); chauthi identity se \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\).)
2. \(\sin 7\theta - \sin 3\theta\) ko product banaiye. (Jawab: \(2\cos 5\theta\sin 2\theta\).)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Product se sum: \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\), \(2\cos\alpha\sin\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\), \(2\cos\alpha\cos\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\), \(-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)\).
2. Sum se product: aadha jor \(\frac{P + Q}{2}\) aur aadha farq \(\frac{P - Q}{2}\).
3. Minus sirf \(\sin\sin\) aur \(\cos P - \cos Q\) mein hai.
4. 2 ka factor na ho to 2 se multiply aur divide karo (teen factors hon to 4 se).
5. Aakhir mein \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\), \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\), \(\cos(90^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin\theta\), \(\cos(180^{\circ} - \theta) = -\cos\theta\) kaam aate hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Minus bhool jana: \(\cos P - \cos Q = -2\sin\frac{P + Q}{2}\sin\frac{P - Q}{2}\), aur \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\).
2. 2 ke baghair formula lagana: \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \frac{1}{2}[\sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)]\), aadha zaroor lagaiye.
3. Poora jor le lena, aadha nahin: \(\sin 5x + \sin 7x \ne 2\sin 12x\cos 2x\).
4. Pehli do lines mila dena: \(\sin\cos\) mein plus, \(\cos\sin\) mein minus.
5. Kitab ki (vii) wali ghalti yaad kar lena: \(\cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\) mein plus hai.
